title: Website Contact, Social & SEO Intelligence Extractor Input
description: Provide up to 100 website URLs to extract clean B2B contact details (emails, phones, social links), on-page SEO signals (title, meta description, H1, robots.txt, sitemap.xml), and technology stack hints without heavy headless browsers.

urls.title: Website URLs (max 100)
urls.description: List of website URLs to analyze (up to 100 URLs per run). Supports full URLs (e.g. `https://example.com`) or bare domains (`example.com`).

checkContactPage.title: Auto-Check /contact & /about Pages
checkContactPage.description: When enabled (default), if no email is found on the homepage, automatically fetches `/contact`, `/about`, and discovered internal contact links to capture business emails, phones, and social links.

timeoutMs.title: HTTP Request Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds to wait for each HTTP request before timing out (1000–60000 ms).

concurrency.title: Max Concurrent Websites
concurrency.description: Number of websites processed concurrently (1–20). Default 5 balances speed with polite target server load.
